title: Please help! Does anyone know this movie?

commenti.body: There is a Spanish-Polish horror movie called "Sweet Home" from 2015. I looked it up and it describes hooded figures running around assaulting people. The plot is something about evicting tenants from a property. A father and daughter are mentioned as key characters.
No, it’s not that one. I checked. 😂
Post this to r/tipofmytongue, they’re really good and finding shit
